title: Semantic Logger Truncation Marker
description: Core-owned root point recorded at flush when the session reached its record limit. Opens and events beyond the limit were not recorded; closes of already-recorded opens still were, so every recorded interval keeps its close. This is not a diagnostic: reaching the limit is a size bound, not a logging failure, and the validator lists it as a warning.

limit.description: The session's record limit (SemanticLogger constructor argument).

dropped.description: Number of opens, events, closes of unrecorded opens and diagnostics that were not recorded.

firstDroppedType.description: Type of the first record that was not recorded.
